note: Experimental frequency-ratio target based on the measured Sysoi bell at Rostov Uspensky Cathedral, Table 1 in Aldoshina & Nicanorov, AES 108th Convention preprint 5117 (2000): F1/F2=0.51, F3/F2=1.26, F4/F2=1.64, F5/F2=2.19. F2 is used as prime. This is one measured historical exemplar, not a universal Russian Orthodox tuning law. Amplitude terms are disabled because the published SPL values are strike/time/measurement dependent and are not a transferable modal-amplitude target.
